{{CharInfobox| color={{grass color}} | corecolor={{ground color light}} | bordercolor={{green color dark}} | name=Mr. White | jname=ホワイト | tmname=White | slogan=no | image=Mr. White.png | size=301px | caption=Mr. White | gender=Male | hometown=[[Arborville]] | region=[[Johto]] | relatives=Unknown | trainer=no | game=no | leader=no | team=no | brain=no | anime=yes | epnum=M04 | epname=Celebi: The Voice of the Forest | enva=[[Marc Thompson]] | java=Takashi Fujii | }} '''Mr. White''' (Japanese: '''ホワイト''' ''White'') is a supporting character who appeared in ''[[M04|Celebi: The Voice of the Forest]]''. He is a resident of [[Arborville]] in [[Johto]]. ==History== {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} first met White when Ash was about to miss the {{wp|riverboat}} {{an|Brock}} and {{an|Misty}} had already boarded. White was the one to catch Ash right before he hit the water, pulling him aboard to safety with Brock's help. When he found out their interest in Pokémon, he suggested taking them to his hometown, [[Arborville]], a treetop town much like [[Fortree City|one location in Hoenn]]. His [[Transportation in the Pokémon world|personal watercraft is also a flying boat]], the foils becoming inflated and capable of lifting the boat, and at least seven average-weight passengers into the air. With this vehicle, he took them to Arborville. He was seen again later when {{OBP|Diana|M04}} and [[Towa]] asked him to take them to the area of the forest wracked with explosions. By the time they found Ash, his friends, and [[Sam]]my, the [[Iron-Masked Marauder]] was already beginning his rampage on the forest, with {{OBP|Celebi|M04}} under his control. In consequence of following them, White's boat was destroyed in the confrontation with the wooden monster created by Celebi. White was a witness to the remaining events of the movie. He later appeared during the credits, flying Ash and his friends back to another town in a seemingly new boat. ==Character== Mr. White is a well-regarded person in his community. He readily offers his assistance to those in need and will happily escort people in his personal [[Transportation in the Pokémon world|flying boat]]. He is also not above the use of violence, as he was shown to be threatening the unmasked Iron-Masked Marauder by cracking his knuckles. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{grass color}}|bordercolor={{ground color light}} |ja=藤井隆 ''Takashi Fujii'' |en=[[Marc Thompson]] |he=יובל סגל ''Yuval Segal'' |de=Benedikt Weber |fi=Antti Jaakola |no=Benjamin Helstad |pt_br=Wendel Bezerra (original dub)
